factors.name: Independent live website exists
factors.note: No independently owned or operated website exists for this specific location. Direct fetch of kwikkar.com/locations, the North Texas franchise group's own directory, lists 26 Dallas-Fort Worth area locations and does not include Melissa. The national corporate site (kwikkaronline.com) only offers a zip-code store locator with no static page to confirm against. Three plausible domain guesses (kwikkarmelissa.com, kwikkarofmelissa.com, melissakwikkar.com) all failed to resolve. Per methodology, category score is 0 when no site exists rather than averaged against inapplicable sub-factors.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: No direct Google Maps UI check was possible in this environment, but strong indirect evidence of an active, substantial Google-linked review presence exists: a third-party aggregator (Carfax) cites a verified 4.9 rating across 275 reviews under this exact business name and city. That volume is consistent with an established, reasonably complete listing, but hours, category, and pin accuracy were not directly confirmed, so this is partial credit rather than full marks.

factors.name: NAP consistency across listings found
factors.note: Excluded from denominator. Only one true public-facing listing surfaced (the Carfax aggregator), with no independent website or second NAP source to cross-check against. A Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation construction permit for this address lists a tenant contact name and phone, but that is a regulatory filing contact, not a customer-facing published number, so it is not a valid NAP comparison point.

factors.name: Appears in results for the primary local query tested
factors.note: Surfaces by name, with its rating, for the broader query 'auto service Melissa TX,' alongside Christian Brothers Automotive Melissa and Provision Automotive. Did not surface at all for the more specific 'oil change Melissa TX' query, where only out-of-town chains (Valvoline in Princeton, Pep Boys in McKinney) appeared. Labeled Likely rather than Verified since live Maps rank position was not directly checked.

factors.name: Review volume relative to the competitor set identified in this audit
factors.note: 275 reviews is high relative to the two Melissa-based competitors identified: no public review count was found for Christian Brothers Automotive Melissa, and Provision Automotive showed zero reviews on the one aggregator checked (consistent with being a smaller, newer operation). Labeled Likely since the exact source platform behind the 275 figure (Carfax's own collection vs. a Google feed) was not independently confirmed.

factors.name: Rating
factors.note: 4.9 out of 5 across 275 reviews, with 93% five-star, per the Carfax aggregator.

factors.name: Recency, at least one review in roughly the last 6 months
factors.note: Excluded from denominator. Review text excerpts found describe specific, detailed experiences (naming a staff member, describing a specific service decision), which suggests an active review flow, but no dated review was found to confirm recency directly.

factors.name: Owner responses present on any reviews
factors.note: Excluded from denominator. No evidence found either confirming or ruling out owner responses; this would require direct access to the Google Business Profile or Maps UI, which was not available in this environment.

factors.name: Business identity stated clearly and consistently somewhere crawlable
factors.note: Name and address are stated consistently across the Carfax aggregator listing and a public Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation permit record, both crawlable. No owned source exists, so this relies entirely on third-party and government records rather than anything the business controls.

factors.name: Structured data / consistent NAP an AI system could read
factors.note: No schema or owned structured data exists anywhere (no owned website). Address is at least consistent across the two sources found, which is a low bar, not confirmed structured data.

factors.name: Content directly answering likely customer questions
factors.note: No content was found anywhere answering basic customer questions (hours, specific services offered, walk-in vs. appointment, pricing approach). The only text available about this business is third-party review excerpts.

factors.name: No contradictory facts across sources checked
factors.note: Nothing contradicts across the two sources found (address matches), but only two real sources exist to check against, so this is weak partial credit, not confirmed consistency across a meaningful number of sources.

technical_findings.finding: No independently owned or operated website exists for Kwik Kar of Melissa, and the location does not appear in the North Texas franchise group's own directory of area locations.
technical_findings.evidence: Direct fetch of kwikkar.com/locations returned a static list of 26 locations across Plano, Allen, Frisco, Richardson, Irving, Waxahachie and other DFW-area cities; Melissa is not among them. The nearest listed locations are Prosper and The Colony.

technical_findings.finding: The national corporate site (kwikkaronline.com) relies on a zip-code based store locator with no static, crawlable directory page, so it could not be used to independently confirm or rule out a listing for this address.
technical_findings.evidence: Direct fetch of kwikkaronline.com shows a homepage with an address/zip search tool and a general '350+ locations across eight states' claim, but no static list of individual stores.

technical_findings.finding: No working independent domain was found for this location under several plausible name variations.
technical_findings.evidence: kwikkarmelissa.com, kwikkarofmelissa.com, and melissakwikkar.com all failed to resolve to any page.

technical_findings.finding: The business's public-facing presence online consists almost entirely of third-party aggregator and government-record pages rather than anything it owns or controls.
technical_findings.evidence: A Carfax review aggregator page and a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation construction permit record are the only two substantive sources found naming this business at this address.

local_findings.finding: A Google-linked review presence appears to be active and substantial (4.9 rating, 275 reviews), but this was confirmed only through a third-party aggregator, not a direct check of the Google Maps listing itself.
local_findings.evidence: Carfax aggregator page (carfax.com/Reviews-Kwik-Kar-of-Melissa-Melissa-TX_FOZMK3E0TA) cites a 4.9 rating across 275 verified reviews, 93% five-star, for this exact business name and city. Direct fetch of this page returned HTTP 403 in this environment, so the figure is from the indexed search snippet, not a page Claude personally rendered.

local_findings.finding: The business surfaces by name for a broad local-service query but not for a narrower, high-intent oil-change query.
local_findings.evidence: 'auto service Melissa TX' returned Kwik Kar of Melissa by name with its rating, alongside Christian Brothers Automotive Melissa and Provision Automotive. 'oil change Melissa TX' did not surface Kwik Kar of Melissa at all; results were dominated by out-of-town chains (Valvoline Instant Oil Change in Princeton, Pep Boys in McKinney).

local_findings.finding: No phone number for this specific location could be independently confirmed in this environment.
local_findings.evidence: Multiple targeted searches for a published customer-facing phone number returned only a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation permit contact (a tenant representative's number tied to the original construction filing), which is not confirmed to be the business's current public phone line.

aeo_findings.finding: Name and address are stated consistently across the sources found, but every one of those sources is third-party or governmental, not something the business owns.
aeo_findings.evidence: Carfax aggregator and the TDLR permit record agree on '2411 Sam Rayburn Hwy, Melissa, TX 75454' under the Kwik Kar of Melissa name.

aeo_findings.finding: No content exists anywhere crawlable that answers basic customer questions an AI assistant would need to recommend this business with confidence (hours, specific services, walk-in policy).
aeo_findings.evidence: No owned website, no FAQ, no service list controlled by the business was found; only review excerpts touching on specific past experiences.

review_findings.finding: 275 reviews at a 4.9 average, with 93% five-star, is a strong, substantial reputation for a single quick-lube location.
review_findings.evidence: Carfax aggregator snippet; sample excerpts describe fast, professional service, a clean waiting area, and one reviewer naming a specific staff member ('Cody') for recommending a better repair than what was initially requested.

review_findings.finding: No distinct Yelp, Facebook, or BBB listing was found for this specific location, despite other individual Kwik Kar locations elsewhere in Texas having their own BBB profiles.
review_findings.evidence: Targeted searches for 'Kwik Kar of Melissa Yelp,' 'Kwik Kar of Melissa Facebook,' and 'Kwik Kar Melissa TX BBB business profile' each returned only the Carfax aggregator or unrelated Kwik Kar locations in other cities (Azle, Marble Falls).

review_findings.finding: The strong review reputation found is not confirmed to appear anywhere this business controls; it currently lives entirely on a platform the owner does not own.
review_findings.evidence: No owned website or business-controlled page was found to display or link to this review record.

methodology_notes: No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Maps-ranking API access for this business; all findings are from public web search, direct page fetches, and public regulatory records. The Carfax review page itself returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch (both via WebFetch and curl with a browser user agent), so the 4.9/275 review figure is taken from the indexed search snippet, not a page personally rendered, and is labeled Likely rather than Verified for that reason. No direct Google Maps UI check was possible in this environment, so GBP completeness, review recency, and owner-response presence are either partial-credit Likely findings or explicitly excluded as Unknown rather than scored as zero. This session's web search budget (shared across a parallel batch of 8 audits) was exhausted partway through research; two planned follow-up queries on review recency and owner responses could not be run, which is why those two reviews_reputation sub-factors are marked Unknown and excluded from the denominator rather than scored. No screenshots were captured; this environment did not have interactive browser access to the live Google Maps listing to capture one.
